name: Heward's Handy Haversack

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: A backpack holding 120 lb in three extradimensional pouches; it always weighs 5 lb, and things come out at once.
text: Each of this backpack's three pouches (a large central one flanked by two side pouches) opens onto an extradimensional space. A side pouch takes as much as 20 pounds, within 2 cubic feet; the central pouch holds up to 80 pounds within 8 cubic feet. No matter what's inside, the pack weighs 5 pounds. Stowing an object follows the usual rules for interacting with objects, but pulling one out takes a Bonus Action, and whatever item you reach for is always magically sitting on top. Overloading, piercing or tearing the haversack ruptures and destroys it. Turned inside out, it spills its contents unharmed and can't be used until it's set right again. Putting it inside a Portable Hole, a Bag of Holding or any similar extradimensional space destroys both at once and tears a gate open to the Astral Plane.
